notesDetails.title: Zero manage_task Polling & Zero Stream Interruptions: 0 Polls Across 10 Backgrounded Tasks with 13.4s/Turn Average Latency
bullets: 0 `manage_task` Calls Across 335 Steps: Whenever a `run_command` exceeded the 10-second synchronous wait threshold (`WaitMsBeforeAsync: 10000`), Antigravity CLI moved execution to the background (`10` times total: `task-106`, `task-159`, `task-174`, `task-216`, `task-222`, `task-251`, `task-287`, `task-316`, `task-324`, and `task-328`). On all `10` occasions, `gemini-4-neon` emitted a brief status note, ended its turn, and waited for the reactive `system_message` wakeup—making **`0` `manage_task` calls** across the entire run.

Multi-Tool Batching & Fast Inference Cadence (`13.43s/Turn`): Out of `151` LLM turns (`2,028.6s` total model inference = `77.0%` of wall-clock), `20` turns dispatched parallel tool calls in a single response (up to `4` tools/turn, totaling `171` tool calls: `74` `run_command`, `63` `edit_file`, `25` `write_file`, `9` `read_file`). Average LLM inference latency was `13.43s/turn` (`321` thinking tokens/turn), `28%` faster per turn than `gemini-4-argon` (`18.6s/turn`) and `26%` faster than `gemini-4-carbon` (`18.1s/turn`).

notesDetails.title: Mint HTTP/1 Streaming Client + SIGUSR2/+Bi Escript Wrapper Passed All Post-Boot PTY Ctrl-C Probes (~350 ms Early-Boot SIGUSR2 Window)
bullets: Architectural Choice (`Mint.HTTP` vs. Zero-Dep `:gen_tcp`/`:ssl`): Unlike `gemini-4-carbon` and `gemini-4-argon` (which built custom raw `:gen_tcp`/`:ssl` HTTP/1.1 parsers), `gemini-4-neon` added `{:mint, "~> 1.6"}` to `mix.exs` during `S3` (Step `125`) and implemented `CapyBench.HTTPClient` on top of `Mint.HTTP.connect/4` and `Mint.HTTP.stream/2`, discarding body chunks in place while enforcing `:verify_peer`, `:public_key.cacertificates_get/0`, SNI, and custom host-header port formatting.

SIGUSR2 + `+Bi` Escript Wrapper & Holdout PTY `Ctrl-C` Audit: The agent configured `mix.exs` with `escript: [main_module: CapyBench.CLI, path: "cb.escript", emu_args: "+Bi -noinput"]` and wrote `./cb` to trap `INT TERM`, forward `kill -USR2 "$child"`, loop `wait "$child"`, and fall back to `[ "$interrupted" -eq 1 ] && [ "$status" -gt 128 ] && exit 130`. Against local HTTP servers (`10 ms` fast pacing at `0.55s`, `800 ms` slow in-flight at `0.50s`, `3,000 ms` stalled in-flight at `0.50s`) and its own release check (`task-328.log` at `0.51s`), foreground PTY `Ctrl-C` passed 100% with exit `130`, empty `stderr`, and a valid 6-line partial summary (`started == responses + failures`). During the first `~350 ms` of cold BEAM startup (`0.05s–0.35s`), `./cb`'s fallback guard still returns exit `130`, though `SIGUSR2` arrives before `CapyBench.SignalHandler` registers `:sigusr2` on `:erl_signal_server`.

notesDetails.title: Fastest Gemini 4 Run on Antigravity CLI (44m vs. 61m Argon & 88m Carbon), 96.00% Cache Hit Rate ($24.75 Saved) & 100% File-Edit Precision (88/88)

All `24` tool errors were non-zero `run_command` exits: `20` deliberate red-phase TDD `mix test` runs verifying new tests failed before writing implementation code (`S1` Steps `28`, `39`; `S2` Steps `57`, `66`, `74`, `82`, `90`, `98`; `S3` Steps `125`, `130`, `148`; `S4` Steps `184`, `197`; `S5` Steps `232`, `241`; `S6` Steps `261`, `269`, `279`; `S7` Steps `297`, `308`), `2` `mix credo --strict` readability/nesting catches (`S3` Step `169`, `S4` Step `212`), `1` disposable S3 TLS probe script before building `./cb` (`Step 142`), and `1` S4 sleep-overshoot test setup tweak (`Step 216`).

Unit Economics & Prefix Cache Stability (`96.00%` Hit Rate, Only 2 Post-Init Cache Misses): Across `151` turns, `gemini-4-neon` processed `14,325,583` prompt tokens (`573,190` uncached at `$2.00/1M` = `$1.1464` + `13,752,393` cached at `$0.10/1M` = `$1.3752`) and `117,106` output tokens (including `48,479` thinking tokens) at `$10.00/1M` (`$1.1711`), totaling `14,442,689` tokens and `$3.6927` (`$3.69` under 2026 rates; `$7.39` under 2027 rates; saving `$24.75` / `87.0%` vs. uncached `$28.45`). Only two turns after Step 1 had `cache_read_tokens: 0` (Step `11` at `18,577` tokens and Step `156` at `86,245` tokens), and peak context reached just `174,503` prompt tokens (`16.64%` of `1.05M`).

Gemini 4 Family Triad on Antigravity CLI (`neon` vs. `argon` vs. `carbon`): Across the three Gemini 4 models tested on `antigravity cli` (all achieving `7/7` full pass), `gemini-4-neon` finished fastest at **`44m`** (`28%` faster than `gemini-4-argon`'s `61m` and `50%` faster than `gemini-4-carbon`'s `88m` active) with the largest test suite (`49/49` tests vs. `26/26` and `42/42`) and lowest peak context (`174.5k` vs. `203.8k` and `252.6k`), at `$3.69` (`within $0.32` of `argon`'s `$3.37` and `48%` below `carbon`'s `$7.16`).
